name: A Wild Catgirl Appears!
source:
A Wild Catgirl Appears follows the story of Ami, a loner at high school, as she joins the school's coding club and sets about making her first video game. They create Starla, an awesome catgirl ninja and create a figure to interact with their game. The figure doesn't quite work, but the next day Starla is quite real!

[From [url=http://newwestgames.itch.io/a-wild-catgirl-appears]itch.io[/url]]

Created for the [url=http://itch.io/jam/yuri-game-jam]Yuri Game Jam[/url].
translation:
《野猫女孩的出现》讲述了高中时孤独的阿美的故事，她加入了学校的编程俱乐部，并开始制作她的第一个视频游戏。他们创造了Starla，一个很棒的猫女忍者，并创造了一个人物来与他们的游戏互动。这个数字不太管用，但第二天斯塔拉就变得非常真实了！

[来自[url=http://newwestgames.itch.io/a-wild-catgirl-appears]itch.io[/url]]

为 [url=http://itch.io/jam/yuri-game-jam]Yuri Game Jam[/url] 创建。
